statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); git_branch=$(cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); git_status=$(cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null && git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); dir_name=$(basename "$cwd"); printf "\033[0;37m %s\033[0m" "$dir_name"; if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then printf "\033[0;37m  %s\033[0m" "$git_branch"; fi; if [ "$git_status" -gt 0 ]; then printf "\033[0;36m [%s]\033[0m" "$git_status"; fi; if [ -f "$cwd/package.json" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node_version=$(node --version 2>/dev/null | sed 's/v//'); printf "\033[0;32m %s\033[0m" "$node_version"; fi; printf "\033[0;33m %s\033[0m" "$model"
